academic.noBundlesBody: A bundle gathers the supplies for one year of one faculty into a single basket.
academic.notVerifiedYet: Your student account is under review — student pricing applies once your card is approved.
academic.addedPartially: Added {{added}} of {{total}} — the rest is unavailable right now:
academic.studentNumberHint: Optional — helps approve your student card faster
academic.setupHint: Complete your academic details to see your faculty bundles and get student pricing on your orders.
academic.pendingVerification: Your details are saved and awaiting student-card approval. Upload it from:

academic.yearsHint: Controls which bundles reach students — a year-5 bundle in a 4-year faculty reaches nobody
academic.noItems: No items — students see this bundle empty until it is filled
academic.activeHint: Active — appears in signup and bundles

academic.confirmDeleteFaculty: Delete this faculty? Its departments, bundles, and students lose their link to it.
academic.confirmDeleteBundle: Delete this bundle and all its items?
academic.confirmPromote: Promote every student in {{faculty}} by one year? This cannot be undone with a click.
academic.promoted: {{count}} students promoted — final-year students were not
academic.needUniversityFirst: Add a university first — a faculty must belong to one.
academic.noUniversitiesBody: Students pick their university at signup — without one, signup cannot complete.
academic.noDepartmentsBody: Departments are optional — many faculties have no internal split.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Updates about your orders, payments and shipments arrive here.
notifications.preferencesHint: Choose what reaches you and on which channel. Account and system alerts cannot be turned off.

images.title: Images
images.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB
images.badType: Unsupported format — JPEG, PNG or WebP
images.emptyBody: A product without an image looks empty in every list.

pos.openingFloatHint: Cash already in the drawer — it counts toward closing reconciliation
pos.noRegistersBody: The POS cannot open without at least one register on a sellable location.
pos.searchPlaceholder: Scan a barcode or type a name…
pos.emptySaleBody: Scan a barcode or search by name to add an item.
pos.reasonHint: Required — without it a closing variance cannot be explained

pos.registerActiveHint: Active — appears in the cashier gate

finance.title: Profit & loss
finance.noAccessBody: Financial reports need an explicit permission — ask the system owner.
finance.unreliable: Warning: {{count}} units sold at unknown cost — profit is overstated.
finance.pendingExpenses: Expenses awaiting approval ({{amount}}) are excluded from this figure.
finance.incurredOnHint: When it was incurred, not entered — March rent belongs to March

b2b.title: Trade account
b2b.noAccessBody: Credit management needs an explicit permission — ask the system owner.
b2b.licenseExpired: Your licence expired on {{date}} — renew it to resume buying on credit.
b2b.overdueWarning: You have {{count}} overdue invoice(s) totalling {{amount}} — settle them to resume credit purchases.
b2b.suspendWarning: Suspending blocks credit purchases immediately. The granted limit is kept.
b2b.licenseExpiryHint: An expired licence blocks credit purchases — blank counts as valid
b2b.licenseExpirySelfHint: Update it as soon as you renew to restore credit purchasing
b2b.licenseExpiredNotice: Licence expired — credit is blocked on this account until renewed.
b2b.licenseExpiredSelf: Your licence has expired and credit purchasing is blocked — update the date once renewed.
b2b.noLedgerBody: The first credit order appears here.

staff.noAccessBody: The staff portal needs an active employee profile — contact management.
staff.targetsPending: Targets and commission are not configured yet — they arrive with the targets system. The figures below are actual sales.
staff.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or number…
staff.searchStaff: Search by name or employee number…
staff.noCustomersBody: Ask your manager to assign customers to you.
staff.pricingNote: The total is computed by the system from the customer's tier — do not quote a figure before the order is created.
staff.pickEmployeeFirst: Pick an employee first, then assign customers to them.
staff.rolePermissionsNote: The role is created here and its permissions are assigned from the Django admin — a role with no permissions opens an empty screen for whoever holds it.
staff.deactivateNote: Deactivating does not end their customer assignments — that is a separate action.
staff.noAssignmentsBody: Assignment links a customer to their rep — commission follows it.

targets.title: Targets & commissions
targets.noTarget: No target set for this month yet — the figures below are actual sales.
targets.belowMinimum: You are below the minimum ({{minimum}}%) — no commission is earned until you pass it.
targets.noCommissionsBody: Press “Calculate commissions” after closing this month's targets.
targets.schemeTiersNote: Tiers are added after the rule is created — a rule without tiers calculates nothing.
targets.minimumHint: Below this percentage no commission is paid
targets.sharedValueHint: Applied to everyone without a specific value
targets.bulkNote: Existing targets are skipped, never overwritten — rerunning creates only what is missing.

reports.title: Reports
reports.noAccessBody: Reports expose sales, profit and every employee's performance — an explicit permission is required.
reports.profitUnreliable: Some orders have unknown cost — the profit figure is overstated.

traffic.title: Traffic & Load
traffic.hint: Who is using the system now, and when the real pressure lands
traffic.estimateNotice: Visitor counts are an **estimate, not a census**: switching networks counts twice, sharing an office network counts once. Good enough to measure load, not to count customers.
traffic.noTraffic: No traffic recorded in this period

products.skuLocked: Fixed after creation — it is printed on shelves and appears on issued orders
products.basePriceHint: Reference for the pricing engine — not the final customer price
products.isActiveHint: Inactive products are hidden from the store
products.imagesAfterSave: Images are uploaded after saving — from the Images button on the product row.
products.confirmDeleteBody: “{{name}}” will disappear from the store and from search results.
products.softDeleteNote: Soft delete: past orders and reports stay intact, and the product returns from the Deleted filter.
products.policyVerifiedOnly: Registered but unverified accounts will not see it.
products.policyNoneConfigured: No default policy is configured — the product will be visible to everyone.

inventory.noMovementsBody: Every stock change appears here — receipts, sales and adjustments alike.
inventory.intro_receive: Incoming quantity with a batch, expiry date and unit cost. That cost is what profit is later calculated against.
inventory.intro_adjust: Correct the balance after a physical count. The difference is recorded as a movement with its reason — the old figure is never overwritten.
inventory.intro_transfer: Move a quantity between locations — two linked movements, so nothing is lost in between.
inventory.intro_damage: Remove damaged stock from what is available. It appears in finance as a loss.
inventory.unitCostHint: Required — without it profit cannot be calculated later
inventory.expiresAtHint: Stock is issued by nearest expiry, not by oldest receipt
inventory.adjustNote: An adjustment never erases the old figure: it is recorded as a movement with its reason, and the log stays complete.
inventory.damageNote: The quantity leaves availability immediately and does not return. Correct it with an upward adjustment, not by deleting this movement.
inventory.pickerPlaceholder: Search by name or SKU, or scan a barcode…
inventory.noCountsBody: Pick a location and start a count — balances are snapshotted immediately.
inventory.countHint: Enter what you actually counted. The expected figure appears after entry to prevent copying it.
inventory.noReservationsBody: Reservations subtract from available stock — none means all stock is available.

branding.draftNotice: This profile is not active — your changes stay hidden from visitors until you activate it.
branding.taglineHint: A short line under the name — shown in the header and in search results
branding.fontArHint: Two separate fonts: a good Latin face may carry no Arabic glyphs at all
branding.fontSizeHint: Between 0.75 and 1.5 — every other size derives from it
branding.radiusHint: Between 0 and 2 — zero means sharp corners
branding.socialHint: Leave a field empty and its link disappears from the store footer.
branding.assetsIntro: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB per file. The logo loads on every page for every visitor — a heavy file slows the whole site.
branding.assetHint_logo_light: Shown in the store header on light backgrounds.
branding.assetHint_logo_dark: A single logo with dark text disappears entirely in dark mode.
branding.assetHint_icon: Square — for the app and sharing.
branding.assetHint_og_image: Shown when the site link is shared — 1200×630.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.noAccessBody: Purchasing needs an explicit permission — purchase prices expose the store's margin.
suppliers.overdueWarning: Invoices past their due date — supply may stop.
suppliers.noOffersBody: Add a supplier offer and it appears here for comparison.
suppliers.reorderHint: Items at or below their reorder point — items with no supplier are flagged, not hidden.
suppliers.nothingToReorderBody: Stock is above its thresholds — no urgent purchasing.

reviews.title: Review title
reviews.bodyPlaceholder: What did or didn't work for you? Concrete experience helps more than a verdict.
reviews.pendingNotice: Your review is checked before it is published — it appears here as soon as you send it.
reviews.editReturnsToReview: Editing sends the review back for checking before it is published again.
reviews.signInToWrite: Sign in to write a review
reviews.moderationHint: Reviews are checked before publishing — only pending ones need action.
reviews.rejectReasonHint: A reason is required: a rejection without one is never explained to the customer, who then rewrites the same text.
reviews.queueEmptyBody: Every pending review has been checked.

payments.refundAmountHint: Leave empty to refund the full remaining amount

reference.hint: Categories, brands and manufacturers — the whole catalogue is built on them.
reference.showInMenuHint: Hiding it does not stop products being assigned to it — this is display, not permission.
reference.isActiveHint: Inactive items disappear from the store but keep their products.
reference.slugNote: The URL identifier is generated from the name and never changes — store links and search engines point at it.
reference.emptyBody_categories: Start with a top-level category — every product needs one.
reference.emptyBody_brands: A brand is optional on a product.
reference.emptyBody_manufacturers: The manufacturer is optional, and it is what regulators ask about.
reference.deleteGuardNote: Deletion is refused while the item is in use — the message names how many things block it.

settings.hint: Settings configured once at setup and rarely touched again.
settings.codeLocked: Fixed after creation — stored data and reports point at it
settings.codeNote: The code is a permanent identifier used in reports and seed scripts — choose it carefully, it never changes.
settings.sellableHint: Quarantine is never sellable — a mislabelled location puts damaged stock in the store.
settings.isDefaultLocationHint: Movements without an explicit location go here.
settings.allowedTypesHint: Leave all unchecked to apply the level alone without restricting by type.
settings.requiresVerificationHint: A registered doctor is not a verified doctor.
settings.denialMessageHint: Shown to the user instead of an empty page with no explanation.
settings.emptyBody_locations: Add at least one warehouse — movements need a location.
settings.emptyBody_expense-categories: A category is required to enter any expense.
settings.emptyBody_policies: A policy answers: who sees this product?

pricing.hint: Price lists, promotional discounts and coupons.
pricing.minQuantityHint: This price applies from this quantity upwards
pricing.priorityHint: Highest wins when more than one list matches
pricing.validToHint: Leave empty for no end date
pricing.accountTypesHint: Leave all unchecked to apply to everyone.
pricing.listNote: A separate list, not a discount percentage: each segment's price stands on its own, so a product can be priced below cost promotionally and what was actually paid can be audited.
pricing.noListsBody: Start with a default retail list.
pricing.noRulesBody: Its customers see the reference price until rules are added.
pricing.endsAtHint: Leave empty for a discount with no end
pricing.overrideNote: A promotion shows in the catalogue with no code — a coupon is typed by the customer. Do not create both for one campaign or the discount applies twice.
pricing.noOverridesBody: A promotion shows directly on the product card.
pricing.maxDiscountHint: Prevents a huge discount on a large order
pricing.usedNote: This coupon has been used {{count}} times — changing its value does not change what was already redeemed.
pricing.noCouponsBody: A coupon is typed by the customer in the cart.
pricing.noRedemptionsBody: The first use appears here with who used it and for how much.

loyalty.title: Loyalty & referral
loyalty.subtitle: Points programmes — switch, targeting, and liability
loyalty.offNotice: Switching off stops new earning; it does not erase balances.
loyalty.bothApply: Both conditions apply together: the customer must match type and segment.
loyalty.activeReferralHint: Rewarded on the first completed order
loyalty.noProgramsBody: Create one to start awarding points — you can switch it off any time.
loyalty.noEntriesBody: The first completed order from a targeted customer appears here.
loyalty.someExpired: {{count}} points have expired and cannot be redeemed
loyalty.redeemHint: Up to {{percent}}% of the order value
loyalty.redemptionPaused: Redemption is paused for now — earning continues.
loyalty.couponReady: Your coupon is ready — use it at checkout
loyalty.couponPersonal: The code is tied to your account and works for no one else.
loyalty.referralHint: You earn {{referrer}} points, your friend earns {{referee}}
loyalty.referralCondition: Paid on the referred friend's first completed order of at least {{amount}}.
loyalty.shareText: Use my code {{code}} when you sign up and get welcome points.
loyalty.noHistoryBody: Your first completed order earns your first points.
loyalty.unavailable: The points programme is not available on your account
loyalty.unavailableBody: It may target another group, or be switched off right now.
loyalty.programStoppedBody: Your balance is kept as is; redemption returns when it is switched back on.
loyalty.codeHint: Lowercase letters and dashes — cannot be changed later
loyalty.createdOff: Created switched off — review the rules, then switch it on
loyalty.createdOffNotice: New programmes are created switched off: set the rules first, then turn it on.
loyalty.confirmDeleteProgram: Delete this programme? Refused if any points were awarded from it.
loyalty.confirmDeleteTier: Delete this tier? Everyone who reached it drops to the tier below at once.
loyalty.noTiers: No tiers — one rate for everyone
loyalty.confirmExpire: Drop every point past its expiry date now?
loyalty.adjustHint: Add or deduct points with no order behind them — recorded with your name and reason.
loyalty.findCustomerHint: Name, customer number, email, or phone
loyalty.notCoveredBody: No loyalty programme covers this customer — the adjustment is refused until targeting is widened.
loyalty.adjustReasonHint: Required — shown on the customer statement and in the audit log
loyalty.deductionCapped: Balance is only {{balance}} — the available amount is taken; customers never owe points.

access.matrixHint: Who sees what — computed by the evaluation engine itself, not read off fields.
access.legend: First cell before verification, second after · ✓ allowed · ✕ denied
access.noPoliciesBody: Add one from the Policies tab and it appears here.

mail.htmlHidden: This message contains HTML - only plain text is shown, as protection against malicious scripts.
mail.imapUsernameHint: Leave empty to reuse the sending username
mail.isDefaultHint: The end of every unassigned route
mail.isMarketingHint: Never carries account or security mail - blocklists hit it first
mail.noDefaultAccount: No active default account - mail falls back to environment settings or is printed to the server log.
mail.noReplyToAuto: Automatic message: replying is blocked to prevent mail loops.
mail.pageHint: Sending and receiving accounts, what each is responsible for, message templates, and the log of what went out and came in.
mail.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current one
mail.replyToHint: An address a human reads - replies to noreply go nowhere
mail.routingHint: Assigned and fell-through-to-default give the same account today and differ tomorrow: changing the default moves everything not explicitly assigned.
